## ReferenceData type

Data form of any reference: what a reference denotes, with no ability to resolve it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ReferenceData = ObjectReferenceData | CollectionReferenceData
```

**References:** [ObjectReferenceData](./contracts.objectreferencedata.md)<!-- -->, [CollectionReferenceData](./contracts.collectionreferencedata.md)

## Remarks

This is what decoding hands to `DecodeContext.bindReference`<!-- -->, with identifiers decoded through the app's resource table, selector positions as `Integer`<!-- -->, containers as nested data, and `app` set from the app contract at every level. It is also exactly what encoding reads: every bound reference is assignable to its data form.
